text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At dusk, I saw Mr. C.B. reading a letter 
in high spirits and decided to call out to 
her—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I just received a wonderful letter. 
...Would you like to read it?

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Morn and night alike, beneath my closed 
eyelids appears Your fleeting form, racing 
past as if in play."

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry for such an awful tanka poem! 
But the moment I saw you racing across the 
turf, this poem just came to my mind!"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text:
"My heart won't stop pounding wondering 
when I'll get to see you run again. I'll 
travel anywhere. Kokura, Sapporo, or even 
overseas!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Right? It's such a passionate fan letter. 
Almost like a love letter."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Having people expect things from me 
isn't really my thing, though."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I can only follow my own heart. If I feel 
the dirt beneath my feet and like how it 
feels, then I'll want to run on dirt 
tracks too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So, I think there are times when you're 
bound to let someone down.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if you say you love the way I 
run... yeah, that makes me really happy."
choice_data_list: Your fans are cheering for you, too.

And the fans are cheering you on just the 
way you are

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu, is that so? I sure hope so.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'm heading outside now, wanna 
come watch me run?
choice_data_list: Huh, even though it's already evening?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"That's just the mood I'm in. I want 
someone to watch me run... that kind of 
feeling."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I can only run for myself. Still, if it 
leaves a mark on someone's heart, then I'm 
sure that's a wonderful thing.
